description:
Loadout Sharing

Ludd spoke: "The holy path, once found, is not the finder’s prize, but the fleet’s inheritance. All things are common among the faithful, that the fleet outlast the night."

Utility mod that lets you copy and paste ship variants as json data.

Requirements

WrapUI (download)

Compatibility

Can be added mid-saveCan be removed mid-saveReleases are always compatible with previous ones

Credits

rolfosian - for providing the reflection librarySCC - for providing the idea for the mod

Ludd spoke: "The holy path, once found, is not the finder’s prize, but the fleet’s inheritance. All things are common among the faithful, that the fleet outlast the night."


     


Utility mod that lets you copy and paste ship variants as json data.

Requirements
  • WrapUI (download)

Compatibility

  • Can be removed mid-save
  • Releases are always compatible with previous ones

Credits

aiDescription: Allows players to copy and paste ship loadouts as JSON data. Enables easy sharing of custom ship configurations between players or saves. Works seamlessly in ongoing games and can be removed without issues.
